integrity.computation: Exact exhaustive checks for small cyclic and noncyclic examples; the general theorem is established by a separate proof.

scientific_limitations: Finite abelian A; field F_q with characteristic not dividing |A|. Modular characteristic and non-Alexander quandles are excluded. The formulas determine rank distributions and ordered zero products, not quandle or algebra isomorphism. Possible implicit equivalence in general Fourier-based literature remains a priority risk.
title: Frobenius-orbit rank spectra of finite Alexander quandle algebras
